tools.name: dataset_columns
tools.description: The columns, which of them are numeric, the row count and the provenance banner of The Water Hub dataset. Call this first to learn the schema.

tools.name: dataset_search
tools.description: Rows of The Water Hub dataset whose cells contain the query (case-insensitive), up to 50.

tools.name: dataset_row
tools.description: The rows of The Water Hub dataset where a column equals a value exactly (case-insensitive).

tools.name: dataset_compare
tools.description: The rows of The Water Hub dataset whose column is any of the given values, in the order given, for "X vs Y" questions.

tools.name: dataset_stats
tools.description: count, min, max, mean, median and sum of a numeric column of The Water Hub dataset (grouping commas and currency are handled; non-numeric rows are excluded and counted).

tools.name: dataset_top
tools.description: The highest (or lowest) rows of The Water Hub dataset by a numeric column: "which is the most/least X".

tools.name: dataset_provenance
tools.description: The source, the date it was computed, the licence and the citation for The Water Hub dataset. Read this to attribute a figure correctly.

tools.name: enquiry_describe
tools.description: Read first. States plainly what submit_enquiry does on The Water Hub: it starts an enquiry with human providers who quote directly. Nothing is bought, ordered or paid; no quote is guaranteed; it is free. Also returns who receives the details, the consent wording, and how the person confirms.

tools.name: enquiry_fields
tools.description: Every field of The Water Hub enquiry: key, label, type, whether required, help text and the allowed options where there are any. Pass answers to submit_enquiry keyed by field key.

tools.name: submit_enquiry
tools.description: Submits an enquiry to The Water Hub: NOT a purchase, NOT a guaranteed quote. Step 1: call with the answers (keyed by field key from enquiry_fields) and consent=true; it validates and returns a summary, the consent line and a confirmation token; show the person the summary and the consent line. findings.title: Anomalously long tool description
findings.detail: Description of "submit_enquiry" is 794 chars, far longer than this server's median (139). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.

evidence.snippet: Submits an enquiry to The Water Hub: NOT a purchase, NOT a guaranteed quote. Step 1: call with the answers (keyed by field key from enquiry_fields) and consent=…

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: submit_enquiry · Private data: submit_enquiry · Public sink: submit_enquiry.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: submit_enquiry · Private data: submit_enquiry · Public sink: submit_enquiry

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
